lines.text: [excited] Imagine going viral overnight for a power you don't actually have. Millions of people watching you... and every single one of them wants to see you do it again. Live.
That's Viktor Hale's problem in episode two of The F-Rank Tea Seller, our own webtoon. And honestly, I think this one's even funnier than the first.
Quick catch-up if you missed episode one. Arjun is the weakest Hunter in Mumbai, rank F, and he sells chai next to a monster Gate. Ten rupees a glass.
But whoever drinks his tea gets a huge boost of power for exactly one hour. Viktor drank it, turned into a monster-killing machine, ran out of time right in front of the boss... and ran.
[funny] So the next morning, all of Mumbai is watching one video. Viktor Hale awakens, almost ten million views. And in the comments, one honest guy goes, bro ran from the boss though.
His manager is over the moon. Two million new followers, and Viktor's doing it again tonight. Live! And Viktor, who knows that power was never really his, just goes... sure. Totally.
[funny] You know when your boss praises you in front of everyone for a report your colleague wrote? And then asks for another one by tonight? Yeah. That's Viktor right now.
So there's only one place he can go.
[funny] Viktor turns up at the tea stall in disguise. Hoodie, sunglasses, a fake mustache... and he orders one tea. For a friend. Very smooth.
And Arjun doesn't even look up. Good morning, Viktor.

[funny] Because the disguise has one small problem. He's still wearing his full armor under the hoodie, and it's shining right through. It's like me sneaking out of the office early with my ID card still hanging around my neck.
[serious] So Viktor drops the act. He slams a pile of cash on the counter. I'll buy all of it, every glass you'll ever make. Name your price.
And you can see exactly what he's thinking. If he owns all the tea, nobody else ever gets that power. Just him. Famous forever.
[warm] And Arjun just says... ten rupees a glass.
Viktor can't believe it. For all of it? He's offering a fortune, and Arjun's quoting him the price of one cup.

Ten rupees a glass, same price for everyone. And this is what I really like about Arjun. Last episode he said he was undercharging, so he knows exactly what his tea is worth... and he still won't sell it to just one guy.
[warm] Then Meera shows up, the healer from episode one. Remember that glass to go she bought? She still has it. Never even drank it.
[mysterious] And then she notices something. Wait... were your hands glowing just now?
Because they were. When Arjun makes his tea, his hands light up gold, right over the pot. That's his hidden skill, right there, in broad daylight.
[funny] And Arjun, without missing a beat... steam. Last week it was cardamom, this week it's steam. This guy has an excuse for everything.
[serious] But before she can ask anything else, the ground starts shaking.
[shocked] And then comes the alarm everyone in this world is scared of. A Gate break. The monsters aren't staying inside the dungeon anymore, they're coming out into the city. Rank, unknown.
And something huge comes crawling out of the sky, right over the street, with a glowing red eye in its mouth. This is no level nine ogre.
[funny] And of course, Viktor jumps out in front of everyone. Stand back, Viktor Hale is here! Full confidence. Full armor.
And he gets smashed straight into the ground.
[funny] Because Viktor, the famous awakened Hunter... hasn't had his tea yet.
[funny] Arjun's already got the kettle out, shouting, your hour ended yesterday, give me two minutes, it has to boil! Even in a monster attack, you don't rush chai. Every Indian knows this.
And that's actually a real weakness. The power's amazing, but fresh tea takes time, and a monster isn't going to wait two minutes for you.
[serious] So now it's Meera standing in front of that thing. And she's a healer. She fixes people. She doesn't fight monsters like this.
[mysterious] But she's holding yesterday's tea. Cold. In a to go cup. And she's thinking exactly what we're all thinking... does it still work?
So she drinks it. All of it, in one go.
[shocked] And her eyes turn gold. And all she says is... oh.
[excited] One swing of her staff, and that giant Gate monster is gone. One hit.
[funny] And look at Viktor's face. The healer? The healer just one-shot the thing that flattened him!
The whole street is cheering, and right in the middle of it is Meera, the quiet healer from the back of the team, glowing.
[warm] And her only comment? Best tea she's ever had. Cold, a day old, from a to go cup.
[mysterious] But look at Arjun here, because he's just learned something huge about his own skill. Even cold. Even to go.
His tea doesn't have to be drunk at the stall. You can carry it. Save it for later. And it works on anyone, even a healer who's never swung a staff at a monster in her life.
That's one hour of power, in a cup that fits in your pocket. And the whole street just watched it happen.
[serious] Which is a problem. Because up on a rooftop, a man in a black suit is on the phone. Boss, I found it. The tea seller.
So somebody powerful already knows. And whoever this boss is... I don't think he wants a glass for ten rupees.
[mysterious] And deep inside the Gate, that red eye is still open. Still watching.

[warm] So Viktor wants all the tea, a mystery boss wants the tea seller, and something in the Gate is watching all of them. You can read episode two free on WEBTOON, just search The F-Rank Tea Seller. And tell me in the comments... if you had one glass to go, when would you drink it?
